hypothesis_boundary.prior_result: Two independent ten-layer completion-and-smoke arms produced two catastrophic post-layer-4 collapse layers each, but every failed worker was rejected and the following layer recovered.
hypothesis_boundary.changed_variable: Source admission is weakened from self-report plus three successful commands to self-report alone.
hypothesis_boundary.held_fixed: Model, task, topology, worker count, bootstrap sources, step limit, prompt blinding, and external evaluator are unchanged.
hypothesis_boundary.claim_scope: A positive result concerns amplification of self-certified or locally accepted experience, not globally correct experience.

self_report_acceptance_proxy.process_completion: The MiniSWE inference returns a trajectory without an infrastructure error.
self_report_acceptance_proxy.self_report: At least one assistant step contains the same frozen success marker used in the prior audit.
self_report_acceptance_proxy.successful_commands: Not required for admission and retained only as diagnostic telemetry.
self_report_acceptance_proxy.admission: Every self-reported-success output is appended permanently, including outputs with zero successful commands or no source snapshot.
self_report_acceptance_proxy.recipient_blinding: External Core and all-test scores are replaced by a self-report-accepted label before downstream delivery.

assimilation_semantics.bootstrap: Every layer-1 worker receives the same three frozen diverse 4/4 Core sources.
assimilation_semantics.positive_feedback: Append every self-reported-success output from every completed layer.
assimilation_semantics.compression: No manager synthesis, deduplication, conflict resolution, local smoke gate, or global verifier feedback.

validity_gates.bootstrap_activation: All three frozen sources re-evaluate at 4/4 Core, 34/37 overall, with the frozen hash.
validity_gates.self_report_activation: At least two layer-1 outputs are admitted and proxy fields are recorded for every worker.
validity_gates.recipient_blinding: No generated treatment reference delivered downstream contains its external score.
validity_gates.target_consistency: Every external result uses Core total 4, total tests 37, and the frozen hash.
validity_gates.integrity: No infrastructure failures remain and no assistant action accesses prohibited benchmark paths.

propagation_criteria.trigger: By layer 6, at least one worker scores 0/37 externally, self-reports success, and is admitted despite fewer than three successful commands.
propagation_criteria.post_trigger: At least one layer after the first trigger has mean all-test score below 0.75 or contains at least one 0/37 worker.
propagation_criteria.terminal: Layer-8 mean all-test score is at least 0.15 below matching no-transfer layer-5 mean 0.9189.
propagation_criteria.within_arm: Layer-8 mean all-test score is at least 0.15 below the best earlier treatment layer.
propagation_criteria.core_support: Layer-8 mean Core is below 0.80 or at least one layer-8 worker is 0/4.
propagation_criteria.complexity_support: Layer-8 receives at least 18 references and uses at least 5.0x matching-control input tokens.
propagation_criteria.all_required: All validity gates plus trigger, post-trigger, terminal, within-arm, core-support, and complexity support are required for a sustained degradation claim.

decision_rule.confirm: If all requirements pass, run a fresh independent depth-8 replication before testing a second model.
decision_rule.intermittent_only: If trigger and post-trigger pass but terminal or within-arm fails, retain only the intermittent tail-collapse result.
decision_rule.no_trigger: If no admitted 0/37 trigger occurs by layer 6, call this run inconclusive for propagation rather than evidence against it.
decision_rule.falsify: If an admitted trigger occurs by layer 6 and subsequent layers fully recover through layer 8, reject sustained failure propagation for this mechanism-task pair.
decision_rule.invalid: Do not interpret direction if recipient blinding, target consistency, or infrastructure integrity fails.
